metric_name: 违规行为纠正与补救程序
query: 违规行为纠正与补救程序 违规行为纠正与补救程序 描述企业在发现内部（如非法雇佣）或供应链中（如供应商违反环境或人权要求）出现违规情况时，所采取的即时行动、长期纠正措施及预防复发的流程。 A. 响应流程得分 (权重 50%) 2分：披露了清晰的“发现-调查-处理”链条（如：立即停职、报警、启动补救方案）。 1分：仅提到“将依法处理”或“会进行整改”，缺乏具体操作步骤。 0分：未说明任何违规处理程序。 B. 机制完备性得分 (权重 50%) 2分：披露了防止违规复发的长期机制（如：定期审计、修订合同条款、供应商拉黑机制）。 1分：仅披露了针对单一事件的处理，无体系化预防措施。 0分：无相关信息。 最终得分 = 0.5×A+0.5×B 纠正措施 补救程序 违规处置 根因分析 复发预防 供应商拉黑 不合规响应 整改闭环 CAPA corrective action remediation procedure violation handling root cause analysis recurrence prevention supplier blacklist non-compliance response CAPA 发现违规后的即时行动链条是什么（停职、调查、报警、启动补救等）？ 长期纠正与预防复发机制有哪些（审计、改合同、拉黑）？ 程序适用于内部非法雇佣还是供应商违规？ 是否有实际案例说明处理过程？ 是否仅停留在“依法处理”表述？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '违规行为纠正与补救程序'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 发现违规后的即时行动链条是什么（停职、调查、报警、启动补救等）？ 长期纠正与预防复发机制有哪些（审计、改合同、拉黑）？ 程序适用于内部非法雇佣还是供应商违规？ 是否有实际案例说明处理过程？ 是否仅停留在“依法处理”表述？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有政策禁令而无违规后的处理表述；仅有申诉渠道；仅有外部处罚新闻而无企业响应或程序。不得排除“将依法处理”“要求整改”等原则性响应；单一事件的实际处理可支持机制完备性1分。区分：本指标评价违规后的响应、补救与防复发；专项政策是禁令，申诉机制是问题入口，争议事件监控评价外部事件暴露。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: Approach to Sustainability / 3.1.3. Ensuring Operations in Compliance
results.text: Significant ESG risks | Potential Impacts | Response Approaches The Group will also assess the supplier's performance in a number of ESG areas, such as product and service quality, ethical conduct and environmental protection. Sun Ferry has set out its ESG requirements for suppliers in the Supplier Code and favours suppliers who demonstrate a commitment to the principles outlined in the Code in the supplier selection process. To verify that our suppliers meet our requirements and drive improvements, we assess the performance of our existing key suppliers annually against the criteria and procedures specified in the Comprehensive Supplier Evaluation Management Scheme. If suppliers fail to meet our requirements, they are required to develop corrective action plans and take corrective action.

results.section: Approach to Sustainability / Preventing Illegal Acts
results.text: The Group established the Whistle-blowing Policy to support the identification and report of any suspicious cases of unethical business conduct or misbehaviour have developed a whistle-blowing system along with the policy to provide a channel for employees and business partners to report or submit a grievance on any misconduct malpractices. All relevant information will be treated in a confidential manner to protect whistle-blowers. Personal details of the whistle-blowers are anonymous to safeguard their rights and personal safety. All complaints and reports will undergo a thorough and fair investigation. During the Reporting Period, there was no legal case regarding corrupt practices were brought against the Group or our employees.

[Section]
Approach to Sustainability / Preventing Illegal Acts

[Content]
The Group established the Whistle-blowing Policy to support the identification and report of any suspicious cases of unethical business conduct or misbehaviour have developed a whistle-blowing system along with the policy to provide a channel for employees and business partners to report or submit a grievance on any misconduct malpractices. All relevant information will be treated in a confidential manner to protect whistle-blowers. Personal details of the whistle-blowers are anonymous to safeguard their rights and personal safety. All complaints and reports will undergo a thorough and fair investigation. During the Reporting Period, there was no legal case regarding corrupt practices were brought against the Group or our employees.

results.section: People-oriented Workplace / Merit-based Remuneration and Promotion
results.text: The Group strictly follows labour laws and regulations in areas where it operates and prohibits any form of child labour or forced labour. To prevent forced labour, the Group properly regulates employees' working hours and rest periods. We would never force employees to work against their wills with violence or intimidation, or by restricting their freedom. To avoid child labour, the Group requires candidates to provide proof of identity and candidates without a valid identity proof would not be considered. In case of child labour and forced labour are discovered, the Group will take immediately actions to stop such from happening.

People-oriented Workplace / Merit-based Remuneration and Promotion

[Content]
The Group strictly follows labour laws and regulations in areas where it operates and prohibits any form of child labour or forced labour. To prevent forced labour, the Group properly regulates employees' working hours and rest periods. We would never force employees to work against their wills with violence or intimidation, or by restricting their freedom. To avoid child labour, the Group requires candidates to provide proof of identity and candidates without a valid identity proof would not be considered. In case of child labour and forced labour are discovered, the Group will take immediately actions to stop such from happening.

results.section: Safety and Health / Passenger and Crew Safety
results.text: To improve fleet safety, all drivers are required to join the safety training to increase their understanding of safety policies and procedures for operating fleet trucks. To avoid poor driving behaviours and accidents that cause serious injury and fatality, we implemented supervisory control and monitoring of drivers. For example, we conduct mandatory alcohol tests with drivers every day before their shifts and monitor the speed and location of our vehicles in real-time. Moreover, regular fleet inspections and maintenance are performed, while the emergency plan and accident analysis are carried out.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
Safety and Health / Passenger and Crew Safety

[Content]
To improve fleet safety, all drivers are required to join the safety training to increase their understanding of safety policies and procedures for operating fleet trucks. To avoid poor driving behaviours and accidents that cause serious injury and fatality, we implemented supervisory control and monitoring of drivers. For example, we conduct mandatory alcohol tests with drivers every day before their shifts and monitor the speed and location of our vehicles in real-time. Moreover, regular fleet inspections and maintenance are performed, while the emergency plan and accident analysis are carried out.

results.section: People-oriented Workplace / 5.2.2. Focusing on Employee Engagement
results.text: The Group issues the Implementation Guide of Talent Development and Management to establish mentorship programme for new recruits. When new recruit is on board, dual mentors, including an integrated mentor and a job-specific mentor, are assigned to each new employee. results.section: Environmental Protection / 7.1.4. Effective Utilisation of Materials and Waste Reduction
results.text: The operation of cargo terminals is vulnerable to severe weather events as they are located close to the coastal areas. The Group pays attention to its terminal operators and cargo safety under unexpected extreme weather caused by climate change. To enhance the preparedness in responding to severe weather events, all subsidiaries under the terminal navigation logistics business of the Group conduct emergency plans for severe weather conditions. Extreme weather such as typhoons and flooding may cause serious impacts to the environment and the Group's business operation. The Group has identified several environmental emergencies that exhibit a high likelihood and has correspondingly formulated the Environmental Emergency Response Plan to outline our strategies and procedures for responding to environmental emergencies. The plan outlines the functions and responsibilities of relevant departments in the event of environmental emergencies. Regular drills are conducted to test the adequacy and effectiveness of the plan.
